local-worker-controls.registeredOnThisCo: Registered on this computer; not started yet.
local-worker-controls.startingWaitingFor: Starting; waiting for the server to accept this Worker. A previous connection lease can delay readiness.
local-worker-controls.workerControllerRu: Worker controller running. Server connectivity and harness readiness are shown separately below.
local-worker-controls.stopIntentSavedWai: Stop intent saved; waiting for the original Worker controller to exit.
local-worker-controls.workerControllerEx: Worker controller exited. Existing session cleanup and recovery remain separate.
local-worker-controls.workerExitIsUnconf: Worker exit is unconfirmed. Startup can continue; previous work may still be running.
local-worker-controls.registrationIsSepa: Registration is separate from startup. The Worker continues after you quit DeliDev. Harnesses must already be installed.
local-worker-controls.stoppingThisWorker: Stopping this Worker interrupts its active work and prevents this controller from reconnecting. Sessions remain saved and may require recovery.
local-worker-controls.theWorkerGeneratio: The Worker generation changed. Refresh and select its current generation before a new stop.
local-worker-controls.theRetainedStopTar: The retained stop targets only its original generation.
local-worker-controls.extra.2f06614e997d: The local Worker could not be inspected. Register it if this computer has no Worker, or inspect its original private scope and device registration.
local-worker-controls.extra.e5f1eb4d93a8: No readable retained Worker was found. Preserve its original scope and inspect its device registration; removal does not create or replace a Worker.
local-worker-controls.extra.fac1a4d002f4: The original stop is unconfirmed. Refresh status or retry that same generation; another Worker will not be stopped.
local-worker-controls.extra.7c9605e7ec95: The local Worker action is unconfirmed. Refresh status before another action. Registration and accepted jobs are preserved.
local-worker-controls.autoManaged: DeliDev automatically starts and maintains this Worker while the app is running. Harnesses must already be installed.
local-worker-controls.autoQuitOwned: This app started the Worker and will stop it when you quit DeliDev. Session cleanup remains separate.
local-worker-controls.autoQuitBorrowed: This Worker was already running. Quitting DeliDev leaves it running.
local-worker-controls.autoChecking: Waiting for the authenticated local connection before checking this Worker.
local-worker-controls.autoRegistering: Registering or checking the original Worker registration before startup.
local-worker-controls.autoRetrying: Automatic management will retry after a temporary failure. A retained startup is never duplicated.
local-worker-controls.autoPaused: You stopped this Worker. Start it explicitly or reopen DeliDev to resume automatic management.
local-worker-controls.autoBlocked: The previous startup or exit could not be confirmed. Inspect the original Worker before taking another action.
local-worker-controls.autoServiceManaged: A user service owns this Worker. Check its original service state; DeliDev does not start a competing Worker.
local-worker-controls.autoPermission: The original registration or permission could not be verified. Check Connection & diagnostics; existing registrations are preserved.
local-worker-controls.autoRunningDescrip: The Worker process is running. Server connectivity and execution readiness are checked separately.
